name: Pine Nuts
siboNotes: Pine nuts are naturally FODMAP-free and well-tolerated in SIBO, providing healthy fats without feeding bacterial overgrowth.
preparationTips: Toast lightly in a dry pan for enhanced flavor and crunch
Store in refrigerator or freezer to prevent rancidity due to high oil content
Add to salads, pasta, or pesto at the end of cooking
Buy from reputable sources as quality varies significantly
nutritionalHighlights: Good source of vitamin E and antioxidants
